changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view [dbo].[IntersectDetail] as with a_a as ( select I.[uid], I.IntersectID as ID, I.IntersectTypeID, I.IntersectTypeUid, S.DisplayValue + ' ' + I.PredicateName + ' ' + O.DisplayValue as Name, I.State,
S.Object as Subject, S.ObjectID as SubjectID, S.DisplayValue as SubjectName, S.DisplayValue as SubjectShortName, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(S.ID) as SubjectUrl, S.Type as SubjectType, S.TypeID as SubjectTypeID, S.UID as SubjectUid, S.TypeName as SubjectTypeName, S.BackColor as SubjectIconBackColor, S.ForeColor as SubjectIconForeColor, S.Icon as SubjectIconText,
O.Object, O.ObjectID, O.DisplayValue as ObjectName, O.DisplayValue as ObjectShortName, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(O.ID) as ObjectUrl, O.Type as ObjectType, O.TypeID as ObjectTypeID, O.UID as ObjectUid, O.TypeName as ObjectTypeName, O.BackColor as ObjectIconBackColor, O.ForeColor as ObjectIconForeColor, O.Icon as ObjectIconText,
I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateType, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateInverse from PredicateIntersect I with(nolock) inner join AssetDetail S on S.ID = I.SubjectAssetID inner join AssetDetail O on O.ID = I.ObjectAssetID ), a_r as ( select I.[uid], I.IntersectID as ID, I.IntersectTypeID, I.IntersectTypeUid, S.DisplayValue + ' ' + I.PredicateName + ' ' + O.Name as Name, I.State,
S.Object as Subject, S.ObjectID as SubjectID, S.DisplayValue as SubjectName, S.DisplayValue as SubjectShortName, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(S.ID) as SubjectUrl, S.Type as SubjectType, S.TypeID as SubjectTypeID, S.UID as SubjectUid, S.TypeName as SubjectTypeName, S.BackColor as SubjectIconBackColor, S.ForeColor as SubjectIconForeColor, S.Icon as SubjectIconText,
O.Object, O.ObjectID, O.Name as ObjectName, O.Name as ObjectShortName, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(O.ID) as ObjectUrl, O.Object as ObjectType, O.ObjectID as ObjectTypeID, O.UID as ObjectUid, O.Name as ObjectTypeName, OS.IconBackColor as ObjectIconBackColor, OS.IconForeColor as ObjectIconForeColor, OS.IconText as ObjectIconText,
I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateType, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateInverse from PredicateIntersect I with(nolock) inner join AssetDetail S on S.ID = I.SubjectAssetID and I.ObjectAssetID = 0 inner join AssetType O on O.ID = I.ObjectAssetTypeID left join AssetTypeStyle OS on OS.ID = O.ID )
select *, case PredicateType when 1 then 'DataLineage' when 2 then 'ReferenceLineage' when 3 then 'InterTypeHierarchy' when 4 then 'IntraTypeHierarchy' when 5 then 'UserOwnership' when 6 then 'Grammar' when 7 then 'Simple' when 8 then 'FusionMapping' when 9 then 'SeeAlso' when 10 then 'Usage' when 11 then 'ObjectOwnerhip' end as PredicateTypeName from a_a union select *, case PredicateType when 1 then 'DataLineage' when 2 then 'ReferenceLineage' when 3 then 'InterTypeHierarchy' when 4 then 'IntraTypeHierarchy' when 5 then 'UserOwnership' when 6 then 'Grammar' when 7 then 'Simple' when 8 then 'FusionMapping' when 9 then 'SeeAlso' when 10 then 'Usage' when 11 then 'ObjectOwnerhip' end as PredicateTypeName from a_r
changeSet.rollback:
create or alter view [dbo].[IntersectDetail] as select I.[uid], I.IntersectID as ID, I.IntersectTypeID, I.IntersectTypeUid, S.Name + ' ' + I.PredicateName + ' ' + O.Name as Name, I.State, I.Subject, I.SubjectID, S.Name as SubjectName, S.Name as SubjectShortName, case when S.AssetID is not null then dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(S.AssetID) else dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(S.AssetTypeID) end as SubjectUrl, S.Type as SubjectType, S.TypeID as SubjectTypeID, S.UID as SubjectUid, S.TypeName as SubjectTypeName, S.BackColor as SubjectIconBackColor, S.ForeColor as SubjectIconForeColor, S.Icon as SubjectIconText,
I.Object, I.ObjectID, O.Name as ObjectName, O.Name as ObjectShortName, case when O.AssetID is not null then dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(O.AssetID) else dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(O.AssetTypeID) end as ObjectUrl, O.Type as ObjectType, O.TypeID as ObjectTypeID, O.UID as ObjectUid, O.TypeName as ObjectTypeName, O.BackColor as ObjectIconBackColor, O.ForeColor as ObjectIconForeColor, O.Icon as ObjectIconText,
I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateType, case I.PredicateType when 1 then 'DataLineage' when 2 then 'ReferenceLineage' when 3 then 'InterTypeHierarchy' when 4 then 'IntraTypeHierarchy' when 5 then 'UserOwnership' when 6 then 'Grammar' when 7 then 'Simple' when 8 then 'FusionMapping' when 9 then 'SeeAlso' when 10 then 'Usage' when 11 then 'ObjectOwnerhip' end as PredicateTypeName, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateInverse from PredicateIntersect I with(nolock) inner join ( select A.ID as AssetID, A.AssetTypeID as AssetTypeID, DisplayValue as Name, Object, ObjectID, ForeColor, BackColor, Icon, Type, TypeID, TypeName, A.UID from AssetDetail A union all select null as AssetID, null as AssetTypeID, NI.Name as Name, 'Intersect' as Object, I.ID as ObjectID, null as ForeColor, null as BackColor, null as Icon, 'IntersectType' as Type, IntersectTypeID as TypeID, NIT.Name as TypeName, I.uid from [Intersect] I inner join IntersectType T on T.ID = I.IntersectTypeID cross apply dbo.GetIntersectNames(I.ID) NI cross apply dbo.GetIntersectTypeNames(T.ID) NIT union all select null as AssetID, TA.ID as AssetTypeID, TA.Name, TA.Object, TA.ObjectID, null as ForeColor, null as BackColor, null as Icon, 'ReferenceItemType' as Type, 0 as TypeID, TA.Name as TypeName, TA.uid from AssetType TA where TA.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' ) S on S.Object = I.Subject and S.ObjectID = I.SubjectID inner join ( select A.ID as AssetID, A.AssetTypeID as AssetTypeID, DisplayValue as Name, Object, ObjectID, ForeColor, BackColor, Icon, Type, TypeID, TypeName, A.UID from AssetDetail A union all select null as AssetID, null as AssetTypeID, NI.Name as Name, 'Intersect' as Object, I.ID as ObjectID, null as ForeColor, null as BackColor, null as Icon, 'IntersectType' as Type, IntersectTypeID as TypeID, NIT.Name as TypeName, I.uid from [Intersect] I inner join IntersectType T on T.ID = I.IntersectTypeID cross apply dbo.GetIntersectNames(I.ID) NI cross apply dbo.GetIntersectTypeNames(T.ID) NIT union all select null as AssetID, TA.ID as AssetTypeID, TA.Name, TA.Object, TA.ObjectID, null as ForeColor, null as BackColor, null as Icon, 'ReferenceItemType' as Type, 0 as TypeID, TA.Name as TypeName, TA.uid from AssetType TA where TA.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' ) O on O.Object = I.Object and O.ObjectID = I.ObjectID
